title: Vampire Vape Tropical Mango Paradise E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: Mango Paradise 50ml Shortfill from Vampire Vape’s Tropical range is a vibrant, sunshine-soaked tropical fruit blend designed for sub-ohm vaping. It balances the smooth, mellow sweetness of ripe Mango with the bright citrus of Blood Orange and the tangy lift of Pineapple for a rich, exotic vape. Each element brings something different: Mango delivers a soft, tropical body; Blood Orange cuts through with a juicy, zesty bite; and Pineapple adds a sweet-sour edge to keep the flavour vibrant and refreshing. The result is a full-flavoured fruit profile that performs beautifully at higher wattages. This 50ml High-VG Shortfill comes in a 60ml bottle, leaving space to add a 10ml nicotine shot if desired. It’s perfect for direct-to-lung (DTL) vaping with sub-ohm vape kits and tanks. Vampire Vape’s Tropical collection introduces a more exotic side to their line-up, blending bold flavours with their signature quality. Also available in Nic Salt, Freebase, 100ml Shortfill formats and Flavour Concentrates.
